incidents.name: NOVO Protocol spot-price reward manipulation
incidents.notes: The NOVO reward contract priced NOVO from the PancakeSwap pair's spot reserves, so a flash loan skewed that price and inflated the payout the attacker could claim.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xa0787daad6062349f63b7c228cbfd5d8a3db08f1 created 2022-05-25T17:05:54Z by 0x0e0c103fdcd6b16ad9e73dbdaec6410a7ad05af6, unrelated to attack sender 0x31a7cc04987520cefacd46f734943a105b29186e; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 248.53 WBNB went to 0x0376564615ae0f59f425bca748076bc25b7b524b in the exploit transaction, consistent with the reported 279 BNB across the incident. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the spot price it read. Loss converted: 279 BNB x $306.38 at incidentTimestamp 1653831938 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $85,479.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xa0787daad6062349f63b7c228cbfd5d8a3db08f1 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x6fb2020c236bbd5a7ddeb07e14c9298642253333, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (333584s -> 333487s)
